factureBtp.metaTitle: E-Invoicing for Construction 2026: Complete Guide — TheNoCodeGuy
factureBtp.metaDescription: Everything construction admin assistants need to know about mandatory e-invoicing in France. Timeline, Approved Platforms, construction specifics, AI agent solution.
factureBtp.title: E-Invoicing for Construction 2026: The Complete Guide for Admin Assistants
factureBtp.hook: In September 2026, all French companies will be required to receive electronic invoices. For the construction industry, it's a headache: progress billing, retention guarantees, reverse charge VAT... Here's everything you need to know.
factureBtp.hookP2: If you're an admin assistant in construction, this article is for you. We'll break down the timeline, the platforms, the industry-specific challenges, and most importantly: how an AI agent can save you weeks of training.
factureBtp.calTitle: The Timeline: What Changes and When
factureBtp.calP1: The reform rolls out in two phases:
factureBtp.calDesc1: Mandatory reception for all companies + mandatory emission for large enterprises and mid-caps
factureBtp.calDesc2: Mandatory emission for SMEs and micro-enterprises
factureBtp.calP2: In practice, from September 2026, even if your construction SME isn't yet required to issue e-invoices, your large clients (Bouygues, Vinci, Eiffage...) will send you electronic invoices. You must be ready to receive them.
factureBtp.paTitle: Approved Platforms: The New Mandatory Gateway
factureBtp.paP1: Forget PDPs — since July 2025, the French tax authority uses the term 'Approved Platforms' (PA). These are the mandatory intermediaries for issuing and receiving electronic invoices between businesses.
factureBtp.paP2: The Public Invoicing Portal (PPF) no longer handles B2B invoice exchange. Its role is reduced to the central directory and tax data concentrator. For everything else, you go through an Approved Platform.
factureBtp.paP3: As of February 10, 2026, over 110 Approved Platforms are registered. The problem? Each client, supplier, and accountant can choose a different one.
factureBtp.btpTitle: Construction Specifics: Why It's More Complex for You
factureBtp.btpP1: Construction is one of the most impacted sectors. Not because the regulation is different, but because your invoices are more complex than in other industries.
factureBtp.btp0Desc: You invoice based on work completion: each progress invoice includes the previous month's percentage, cumulative totals, and deductions. All of this must be encoded in a structured electronic format (Factur-X, UBL, or CII).
factureBtp.btp1Desc: It's no longer just a line at the bottom of the invoice. The retention guarantee must be properly encoded in the electronic format. An error = automatic rejection by the client's Approved Platform.
factureBtp.btp2Desc: In construction subcontracting, you invoice without VAT. The specific VAT regime code must be correctly entered in the structured file. Not all Approved Platforms natively support this specificity.
factureBtp.btp3Desc: Deposit invoices and the Final General Settlement at project completion must also go electronic. That's more documents to format correctly.
factureBtp.douleur0: Juggling between 3 to 5 different Approved Platforms daily
factureBtp.douleur1: Learning new interfaces when you already have 15 tasks in parallel
factureBtp.douleur2: Managing automatic rejections of poorly formatted invoices (VAT code, retention guarantee, cumulative totals)
factureBtp.douleur3: Tracking the status of each invoice on each platform (submitted, received, accepted, rejected, paid)
factureBtp.douleur4: Double entry period during the transition (old system + electronic)
factureBtp.douleur5: Multiplying contacts: software vendor, platform, accountant, bank, suppliers
factureBtp.solutionTitle: The Solution: An AI Agent That Bridges the Gap
factureBtp.solutionP1: What if, instead of training your assistant on 5 different platforms, you hired an AI agent that connects to all of them?
factureBtp.solutionP2: The TheNoCodeGuy AI agent acts as a single abstraction layer between your assistant and the e-invoicing ecosystem:
factureBtp.solution0: Multi-platform connection: one access point instead of 3-5 platforms
factureBtp.solution1: Automatic dispatch: the agent identifies which platform each recipient uses and routes the invoice
factureBtp.solution2: Pre-send validation: automatic compliance check before sending
factureBtp.solution3: Centralized tracking: single dashboard with the status of all invoices across all platforms
factureBtp.ctaDescription: Don't leave your assistant alone facing 5 platforms. Tell us about your construction invoicing, we'll show you how the AI agent simplifies everything.
